name: knowledge-base
description: True RAG over your own Markdown docs: a local ChromaDB vector index plus your embeddings API. Captures new notes back into it. Requires chromadb.

docs_dir.title: Documents folder
docs_dir.description: The indexed corpus: every .md/.markdown/.txt file under here is chunked, embedded and searchable, recursively. REQUIRED. Defaults to the Eva knowledge folder, which is where the word, outlook, confluence and pdf-to-md plugins write their mirrors - so a stock install indexes all of them.

index_dir.title: Index folder
index_dir.description: Where the ChromaDB vector store is kept. Deliberately OUTSIDE the documents folder, so a large binary database does not sit inside the corpus. Derived and disposable: delete it and re-index to rebuild, which you must do after changing the embeddings model.

output_dir.title: Captures folder
output_dir.description: Where kb_capture writes new notes. Must sit INSIDE the documents folder, or captured notes would never be indexed, and must not be a dot-folder. Created on demand.

embed_url.title: Embeddings endpoint URL
embed_url.description: Full URL of your embeddings API. REQUIRED.

embed_model.title: Embeddings model
embed_model.description: Optional. Model name sent in embed requests; omit if the endpoint fixes one.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Absolute path to the python.exe that has this server's pip dependencies installed (e.g. C:\Python311\python.exe). Use plain 'python' only if the right interpreter is first on PATH - a mismatch here is the most common cause of 'dependency missing' errors.
